label: M59, Jewish Babylonian Aramaic bowl for Ardoi son of Kirkshidukh
summary: Jewish Babylonian Aramaic bowl whose spell is a close textual parallel to M50 and MS 1929/16; the Edinburgh teaching page supplies a transcription and English translation, while Levene's dissertation identifies the object as M59.

source.title: Jewish Aramaic Incantation Bowls
source.authors: University of Edinburgh, Jewish Non-Jewish Relations
source.citation: University of Edinburgh, Jewish Non-Jewish Relations, ‘Jewish Aramaic Incantation Bowls,’ primary-source guide, accessed 4 September 2026.
source.notes: Object identification cross-checked against Dan Levene, A Corpus of Magic Bowls (UCL dissertation), pp. 39–40, discoverable at https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10179220/.

appearance.locator: illustrated bowl transcription and translation; identified as M59 via Levene dissertation pp. 39–40
appearance.description: Edinburgh page reproduces an image, transcription, and translation; Levene identifies the client's bowl as M59.

texts.content: Protective spell for Ardoi son of Kirkshidukh, invoking angelic and divine authority against demons and harmful beings; includes Zechariah 3:2.
texts.notes: Non-verbatim summary of the copyrighted translation; full transcription and translation remain linked at the source.

media.notes: Object photograph displayed on the Edinburgh source page; rights holder and reuse permission require review.
